One playable student station plus simulated classmates. Everything stays local to this file.

MISSION BRIEFING

How to play

Answer questions, power up your station, and help your crew protect the base.

1
Answer the question.

Pick your best answer before time runs out.

2
How sure are you?

Pick I'm Sure or Not Sure Yet. This stays private and does not change your score.

3
Send your power.

Most correct answers fire right away. During a Power Charge, tap the crystal until it is full. Then send power to North Gate, Shield, or Power Core.

4
Help your crew decide.

Vote on upgrades and help friendly pods when they appear.

Your screen is private. The class board only shows the crew working together.
